grants.name: Origin Feat: Magic Initiate (Cleric)
grants.text: You learn two cantrips and one level 1 spell from the Cleric spell list.

grants.name: Origin Feat: Crafter
grants.text: You gain proficiency with three artisan's tools of your choice, can craft nonmagical items in a quarter of the usual time, and buy nonmagical items at a 20% discount.

grants.name: Origin Feat: Skilled
grants.text: You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice.

grants.name: Origin Feat: Alert
grants.text: You add your proficiency bonus to Initiative rolls, and can swap your rolled Initiative with a willing ally's.

grants.name: Origin Feat: Musician
grants.text: You gain proficiency with three musical instruments of your choice, and can give allies within 60 feet a d4 to add to an attack roll, ability check, or damage roll, a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

grants.name: Origin Feat: Tough
grants.text: Your hit point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your character level, and increases by 2 again whenever you gain a level.

grants.name: Origin Feat: Alert
grants.text: You add your proficiency bonus to Initiative rolls, and can swap your rolled Initiative with a willing ally's.

grants.name: Origin Feat: Magic Initiate (Druid)
grants.text: You learn two cantrips and one level 1 spell from the Druid spell list.

grants.name: Origin Feat: Healer
grants.text: As an action, you can spend a Healer's Kit charge to let a creature within 5 feet spend a Hit Die to regain hit points, rerolling any 1 on the healing die.

grants.name: Origin Feat: Lucky
grants.text: You gain a number of Luck Points equal to your proficiency bonus; spend one to give yourself advantage on a d20 test or impose disadvantage on an attack roll against you.

grants.name: Origin Feat: Tavern Brawler
grants.text: Your unarmed strikes deal 1d4 + Strength modifier damage and you can reroll a 1 on that damage die, and you gain proficiency with improvised weapons.
